Twinkle governor: a resting gem field glints on blue-noise phases while a meter shows reward motion against the 10% budget
manifest.cap: Twinkle governor. Each gem's glint phase comes from the void-and-cluster blue-noise rank under it, so neighbours never flash together. A token bucket refilled at 6% of the reward pixels per frame grants the glints. A refused glint is skipped, never delayed. Firefly mode couples the gems (Mirollo–Strogatz) so an ignored patch syncs up and calls to the player, and the governor still clips each flash.

manifest.lab: Chest drop: an elite dies, the chest arcs to the clearest nearby spot found on a distance field, lands with a squash and lays a rarity stipple on the ground
manifest.cap: Chest into clear space. When the elite dies, a 3-4 chamfer distance transform runs over everything solid (gems, bats, hero, props, edges). Forty-eight golden-angle candidates around the body are scored by clearance minus a small distance cost. The field draws as closed rings every 7 px of clearance and fades out half a second after the landing, so the landing reads first. The chest arcs to the winner, lands with a damped squash and lays a rarity stipple on the ground, B3 at the core with a sparse B4 rim. Rarity cycles rare, epic, legendary, common.

manifest.lab: Screen clears: the Clearing Bell sends a bone-white ring that turns every enemy it crosses to ash, then the Stopwatch freezes a new crowd in grey frost and counts down around the hero
manifest.cap: Screen clears. The crowd closes in around the lantern. The Clearing Bell gets a 0.7 s ceremony grant: a 2 px bone-white wavefront with a trail of ash turns each enemy it crosses to ash and their drops merge on landing. The Stopwatch freezes a new crowd. Frost creeps in through a Bayer threshold, the OKLCH chroma drops to grey and the ember eyes go out, so frozen enemies lose their threat cue. A bone arc counts down around the hero.

manifest.cap: Gold and healing. The Coin Pouch bursts into ten coins on a golden-angle whirlpool, then each flies on its own beat into the counter. The counter is an odometer: a digit rolls only while every digit below it reads 9. The Picnic Roast heals with a heal-green number and a spring on the HP bar. Gold appears only on money and green only on healing.

manifest.cap: Light from the lid. A slit cookie fans out above the open chest: 3, 5 or 8 slits for common, rare and epic. An evolution keeps 8 slits in one hue that sweeps between violet and magenta (280° to 325°), well away from heal green and XP blue. Light is raymarched outward along 256 polar rays from the mouth, scattered by drifting dust and absorbed by the reels and the plaque, which cast shadow fins. The inset is the polar table S[angle, radius] the screen reads from.

manifest.lab: Reel solver lab: five reels landing in order, a plot of symbols left to travel, and a 10x zoom of the centre reel detent
manifest.cap: Outcome-first reel solver. Each reel is told its symbol and its landing time, then solved backwards: a linear spin, a cubic Hermite approach that matches position and speed at both ends, and a critically damped detent that overshoots by a pixel or two and settles with no wobble. Past 5 symbols a second a symbol cannot be read, so the reel draws a drum smear of its two main colours with one specular line moving at reel speed. Left plot: symbols left to travel. Right plot: the centre detent at 10×.

manifest.lab: Coin lab: a Vogel-launched Verlet coin fountain bouncing into a column heap, then homing into a rolling odometer
manifest.cap: Coin fountain and tally. Coins launch on a Vogel spiral (golden angle 137.5°, radius √i) so the spray is even with no clumps. Position Verlet at 120 Hz with restitution, a lid that kicks coins outward, and a column heap that settles them into a pile. At the tally each coin is handed to an exact critically damped integrator that homes into the counter. The odometer rolls with a carry cascade. In the main render this whole beat runs after the change row, so gold never shares a moment with the burst.

manifest.lab: Evolution lab: left, the evolved reward as it is now, a base whip icon in a gold frame; right, the reel landing on Lantern Lash and flipping pixel by pixel into Ember Lash while a thin-film frame ignites, a decoding EVOLVED tag, and an XOR silhouette of what changed
manifest.cap: Evolution must look evolved. Now: the base whip icon in a gold frame. Target: the reel lands on Lantern Lash, then the pixels that differ flip into Ember Lash in Bayer-ranked order over 0.45 s, each throwing one spark. The thin-film frame ignites outward from the top as the flip completes, and the EVOLVED tag decodes with the same schedule. The XOR silhouette shows the pixels that flip.

manifest.lab: Jump flooding passes over the route seeds, then the soft reveal
manifest.cap: Spectacle · jump flooding. The route is sampled into seeds. Each pass every cell looks at nine cells at distance k (128, 64 … 1, then one more pass of 1) and keeps the closest seed. Nine passes give every cell its nearest seed and its distance. The colour is the seed's order along the route, which is what lets the fog lift along the path the hero took.

manifest.lab: Arcana pick: three tarot cards dealt face down, turning one at a time with a thin-film sheen and Sinkhorn sigil assembly, bone focus cursor
Sinkhorn mote morph into a sigil, and the thin-film colour table
manifest.cap: Spectacle · Sinkhorn morph and thin film. Left: motes from the card-back lattice are matched to sigil pixels by entropic optimal transport. Small ε gives a sharp one-to-one match, large ε blurs every mote toward the centre of mass. Right: the thin-film table, the interference colour of a film of thickness d, posterised to four levels per channel.

manifest.lab: Bestiary: list with unmet entries at B2, turntable sprite with a scan line, marching-squares contour and glyph decode, stat bars
Marching squares over a blurred sprite alpha with a sweep line and the 16-case table
manifest.cap: Spectacle · marching-squares sweep. The sprite's alpha is box-blurred at its own resolution and sampled bilinearly, so the iso-contour cuts the stair-steps into clean diagonals. Cells are tinted by case, the 16 cases on the right light up by how often they occur, and below the sweep the shape survives as edge-aware glyphs.

Geodesic ink-in inside an icon mask beside straight-line distance
manifest.cap: Spectacle · geodesic ink. On unlock the icon inks in from its handle along its own strokes. The distance is a breadth-first flood inside the icon mask, so ink follows the shape. Right: straight-line distance from the same seed jumps every gap and fills parts that are not connected yet.

manifest.cap: 01 · 0.0 s Boot :: The boot bar. It is the only thing on screen that moves.
02 · 2.4 s Logo forms :: The forming logo. Each particle rides an optimal-transport path from the bar to one logo pixel, so no paths cross.
03 · 5.6 s Title :: The wordmark. Lantern gold appears only here on the title, and the shine sweep is the only motion on it.
04 · 8.6 s Main menu :: The logo reflows into the menu header on under-damped springs. Then the focused START button.
05 · 12.0 s Survivor select :: The survivor on the turntable. The candle orbits, so the rim light walks round the silhouette.
06 · 15.8 s Stage select :: The stage name and its preview. The light walks round the diorama and the contours give it shape.
07 · 19.6 s Run start :: Find the hero: a bone core in a protected dark ring, at the centre of a big six-step lantern.
08 · 24.4 s Swarm builds :: Threats at the lantern edge first, then gems. Five or more gems merge into one so drops never flood.
09 · 30.0 s Shot near :: Weapons stack: Lantern Lash, Wisp Wand, Bitter Halo, Storm Bell. Each owns a band and none outshine the hero.
10 · 33.0 s Level up :: The three cards. The world drops to B0 and B1 behind them through a blue-noise dissolve.
11 · 36.6 s Chest :: A chest on the ground. Nothing else near it uses its colours.
12 · 41.2 s Boss warning :: The red edge marker and the warning plate. The whole world ducks one band.
13 · 44.2 s Boss falls :: The boss and its HP bar. When a telegraph lands, read the red disc first and step out.
14 · 49.0 s 30:00 Reaper :: The clock races to 29:50 while the colour drains out of the world.
15 · 54.0 s Lantern out :: The bands go out one by one. The hero is the last thing on screen.
16 · 56.6 s Results :: The results resolve cell by cell from where the hero fell. Read the gold total, then the evolved weapon.
17 · 59.2 s Back to title :: The results burn away into the title, and the run begins again.
